The '''Rebel Phalanx''' was a specialized military unit of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Rebel Phalanx [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were easily recognizable as they wore [[Crusader Mark II armor]]s. They were deployed during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="SWG:BoEB" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel Phalanx appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BoEB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Rebel Phalanx was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Battle of Echo Base|"Battle of Echo Base" instance]],<ref name="SWG:BoEB" /> introduced in the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 11|Chapter 11]]" on [[November 20]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 11: The Battle of Echo Base">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68094&month=112008|text=Chapter 11: The Battle of Echo Base}}</ref>
